title: A Small-Business Website Checklist for Northwest Illinois

cover.alt: Concept illustration of a local contractor planning a clear mobile business website at a workbench.

figures.title: Three answers a visitor should find immediately
figures.summary: The homepage should connect the business offering to an obvious next step.

items.label: What you do
items.detail: Name the service in plain language rather than relying on a slogan.

items.label: Who and where you help
items.detail: Identify the customer and the towns or counties actually served.

items.label: How to contact you
items.detail: Offer one clear form, email, or phone call to move forward.

figures.caption: The article's core clarity check, presented as a visitor's path through the homepage.

figures.title: Run the mobile check before decorating
figures.summary: Test the customer path on an actual phone.

items.label: Read every page
items.detail: Look for cramped text, clipped images, and horizontal scrolling.

items.label: Try the controls
items.detail: Make links and buttons easy to tap without zooming.

items.label: Submit the contact form
items.detail: Confirm that the form works through the complete mobile flow.

items.label: Review speed
items.detail: Use PageSpeed Insights to identify critical issues.

figures.caption: A compact version of the mobile audit checklist in this article.
